product_updates.title: What’s behind the AI industry’s latest warnings of doom?
product_updates.content: On Equity, we discussed the AI industry's latest debate about whether it poses an existential threat to humanity.

product_updates.title: Obama urges Democrats to have a ‘clear plan’ for AI safeguards
product_updates.content: Obama recently said that Democrats need to make artificial intelligence one of their “central agendas” and “have a very clear plan” to address concerns around the technology’s economic impact and safety.
